serverSettings.title: Server
serverSettings.description: The CloudCLI server on this computer, started by the scripts in scripts/server.
serverSettings.testPortal: This is the test portal (port {{port}}). Restart and Stop act on it only.
serverSettings.unavailable: This server was not started by the scripts in scripts/server, so it cannot be controlled here.
serverSettings.pendingBuildHint: Ready to go live: a restart makes it the running build.
serverSettings.activeWorkValue: Replies being written: {{turns}} · sessions with background work: {{sessions}} · background tasks: {{tasks}}
serverSettings.autostartDescription: Start the server in the background when you log in to this computer.
serverSettings.autostartDisabled: Switched off by the system (on Windows: Task Manager > Startup apps). Turning it on here switches it back on.
serverSettings.autostartLiveOnly: Applies to the live server only; change it there.
serverSettings.actionsDescription: Both end every reply being written and all background tasks, and this page loses its connection. After a restart it reconnects by itself; after a stop the server has to be started again on the computer.
serverSettings.confirmRestart: Restart the server now? This page loses its connection for a moment.
serverSettings.confirmStop: Stop the server? This page stops working until the server is started again on the computer.
serverSettings.confirmWork: Running work will be ended and cannot be resumed. {{work}}
serverSettings.restartScheduled: Restarting… This page reconnects when the server is back.
serverSettings.stopScheduled: The server is stopping. Start it again on the computer (scripts/server/start).

showThinking.label: Show thinking
showThinking.description: The same switch as in quick settings.

files.showIgnoredDescription: List gitignored files and folders in the Files tab, dimmed. Same as the eye button there; remembered on this device only.

phone.swipeNavigationDescription: On a phone, swipe left or right to switch workspace tabs; swiping back from the first tab opens the menu.
phone.homeRecents: Recent conversations on the home screen
phone.homeRecentsDescription: With no project open, list the latest conversations and their projects. Off: the original “choose a project” screen.
